title: If you can't control it, *don't think* about it

label: STEP 1
head: Sort the worry in 5 seconds
sub: One question: can I do something about this today? If no, drop it.

label: STEP 2
head: If yes, take the smallest action now
sub: Worried about the exam? Open the book. Worried about money? Cancel one subscription.

label: STEP 3
head: If no, give it a 10-minute window
sub: Write the worry down at 8PM. Read it once. Close the notebook. Done for the day.

head: Your flight is delayed 3 hours
l: Yells at the gate agent, ruins the trip

text: You have power over your mind, not *outside events.* Realize this and you find strength.
